t: You are looking at 10 Downing Street, known as Number 10, the official residence and office of the Prime Minister. It stands in Downing Street, off Whitehall. Recent occupants include Gordon Brown from 2007 to 2010 and David Cameron from 2010 to 2016. Theresa May lived here from 2016 to 2019, followed by Boris Johnson from 2019 to 2022. Akshata Murty also lived here, as the wife of former Prime Minister Rishi Sunak. Andy Burnham is listed as a resident too, and has been Prime Minister since July 2026. The door has changed hands many times, but the address has stayed the same.
